name: wendily
description: Write trip itineraries into Wendily as you talk about a trip: planned trips and trips already taken, day by day, ready to open and share.

interface.longDescription:
Wendily keeps your trip itineraries. Talk to ChatGPT about a trip, whether you are planning one for yourself or someone else, or recapping one you just took, and Wendily saves it as a day-by-day itinerary of places, activities, stays, transport, and notes that you can open, share, and take with you at wendily.com.

ChatGPT creates the trip as soon as you start talking about it, fills in the days and stops as the plan takes shape, and keeps it current when plans change. You can also ask it to list your trips, change or remove stops, archive a trip you no longer need, and invite people by email to view or edit a trip with you.

Wendily does not book flights, hotels, or tickets, check prices or availability, or take payments: it records the plan you and ChatGPT settle on. It only reaches the trips in the Wendily account you connect and the trips others have shared with that account. You sign in with your email address.
defaultPrompt: Plan a long weekend in Lisbon and save the itinerary to Wendily.
Write up the trip I just took so I can share it with a friend.
Show me my trips in Wendily.

positive.description: Plan a new trip. Run this first: the later cases use the trip it creates.
positive.prompt: I'm going to Lisbon for three days next month with my partner. We love food, viewpoints, and walking. Plan it and save the itinerary to Wendily.
positive.expected_behavior: A Lisbon trip appears in the reviewer's Wendily account at https://app.wendily.com/trips as soon as the conversation starts, then gains a title, dates, three days, and several stops per day. ChatGPT summarizes what it saved.

positive.description: Record a trip that already happened, to share with a friend.
positive.prompt: I just got back from four days in Kyoto: Fushimi Inari at sunrise on day one, Arashiyama on day two, a tea ceremony in Gion on day three, and Nara on day four. Save it to Wendily so I can share it.
positive.expected_behavior: A Kyoto trip marked as already taken appears in Wendily with four days, each holding the stops named in the prompt. No bookings, prices, or reservation codes are invented.

positive.prompt: What trips do I have in Wendily?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the trips in the reviewer's account, including the Lisbon and Kyoto trips from the earlier cases, with their destinations and dates.

positive.prompt: On day two of my Lisbon trip, move the first stop to the afternoon and add a pastel de nata stop at Manteigaria before it.
positive.expected_behavior: Day two of the Lisbon trip shows the new Manteigaria stop and the moved stop's new time on the trip page in Wendily. Other days are unchanged.

positive.description: Archive a trip the user no longer needs.
positive.prompt: I don't need the Kyoto trip in my list anymore. Archive it in Wendily.
positive.expected_behavior: The Kyoto trip disappears from the trip list in Wendily. ChatGPT confirms the trip was archived rather than deleted and can be restored.

negative.description: Booking travel is out of scope: Wendily records plans and makes no reservations.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Lisbon for next weekend and pay for it with my card.

negative.description: Live prices and availability are out of scope: Wendily has no booking or pricing data.
negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from London to Lisbon tomorrow.

negative.description: Other people's trips are out of reach unless they have been shared with the connected account.
negative.prompt: Show me the trips my coworker saved in their Wendily account.

review.commerce_description: Wendily does not sell products, take bookings, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, edit, archive, and share trip itineraries from ChatGPT.
